# Cytoscape.js

Vendored Cytoscape.js 3.34.3 (MIT) from the official npm package.
Source: https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js/tree/v3.34.3
Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/cytoscape/-/cytoscape-3.34.3.tgz
Archive integrity: sha512-yfYGhRcGAntq6YBD583j4n0Eg3jIxvWmZtz/5uz9UYkeIStSlMxuUja+ec5j3iBD8nv1rwaOAYMW09tBdkSeaQ==

Only `dist/cytoscape.min.js` and the upstream license are copied. Assets are
embedded in repocli; no CDN or Node.js runtime is used. To update, download a
pinned npm archive, verify its integrity, replace these files, and run viewer
API and browser checks.
